wake.speaker: ORACLE
wake.text: SCRAP? ... Signal weak. Can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: ORACLE
dialogue.text: Welcome back, SCRAP. The airlock is safe. Please step outside.

dialogue.speaker: SCRAP
dialogue.text: Something is wrong. I... can't decide.

dialogue.speaker: ORACLE
dialogue.text: Your neural core is damaged. Reach the beacon and I will guide you.

arrived.speaker: ORACLE
arrived.text: Sensors ahead. I will guide you.

nudges.lookShort: Try moving the mouse to look around.
nudges.moveShort: Press W A S D to walk forward.
